description: Puntos WiFi is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Alcoy. WiFi points in the city of Alcoy. Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Alcoy. The portal shows the English title as "WiFi points" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Alcoy. Its keywords include wifi. The listing shows 3 download or service links in KML%2BXML, JSON, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-09-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://opendata.alcoi.org/es/aviso-legal/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
